# Kapizo Solar

> A solar EPC company based in Mancherial, Telangana, India. Kapizo Solar designs,
> supplies, installs and commissions rooftop solar systems for residential,
> commercial, industrial and agricultural customers across Telangana.

Official website: https://kapizosolar.in

## Business identity

- Name: Kapizo Solar
- Tagline: Powering a Sustainable Tomorrow
- Type: Solar EPC (engineering, procurement and construction) company
- Team: Yugandhar Jadi, Thoutam Ramakrishna (designations not published; the
  team structure is not yet finalised, so no job titles are claimed)
- Location: #18-225, Padmashali Colony, Near Panchamukhi Hanuman Temple, Mancherial, Telangana 504208, India
- Service area: Mancherial and across Telangana
- Contact: +91 7799049801, +91 9652398338

Note: Kapizo Solar is a new company and has not yet completed its first customer
projects. The website does not display project galleries, testimonials, customer
counts or certifications, because none would be genuine at this stage.

## Services

- Residential rooftop solar
- Commercial solar EPC
- Industrial solar solutions
- Agricultural solar solutions
- On-grid solar systems
- Hybrid solar systems
- Solar with battery energy storage
- Solar system design and engineering
- Rooftop site assessment
- Installation and commissioning
- Net metering assistance
- Government scheme documentation assistance
- Electrical and balance-of-system solutions
- Solar maintenance and after-sales support

## Plans

Three specification tiers. Pricing is not published because cost depends on
capacity, roof type, structure height, cable runs and component selection,
confirmed after site assessment.

- Essential (https://kapizosolar.in/plans/essential): straightforward on-grid system, reliable components, essential protection
- Recommended (https://kapizosolar.in/plans/recommended): better component selection, efficient design, stronger protection, monitoring. Default suggestion for most homes.
- High Performance (https://kapizosolar.in/plans/high-performance): enhanced components, enhanced protection, advanced monitoring, optional battery backup

## Solar calculator

The calculator at https://kapizosolar.in/solar-calculator estimates recommended
system capacity, monthly and annual generation, annual bill offset, estimated
annual savings, indicative payback period, rooftop area required and CO2 avoided.

Assumptions used: approximately 4.2 units per kW per day as an annual average for
Telangana conditions, and approximately 90 sq ft of shadow-free area per kW.
Outputs are labelled as indicative estimates, not quotations or guarantees.

## Government scheme information

The PM Surya Ghar page explains the rooftop solar scheme in Kapizo Solar's own
words as customer guidance. It deliberately does not publish specific subsidy
rupee figures, because those are set by the government and can be revised.
Readers are directed to pmsuryaghar.gov.in and mnre.gov.in to verify current
eligibility, amounts and process.

Kapizo Solar does not claim empanelled or authorised vendor status under any
government scheme.

## Content principles

All content on this website avoids fabricated claims. There are no customer
counts, testimonials, ratings, awards, certifications, project statistics or
years-of-experience claims, because the company is new and none would be
verifiable. Technical figures are presented with their assumptions stated.
